title: 'Cocktail 2' box office Day 7 [LIVE]: Shahid Kapoor's film eyes Rs 80 crore mark in India
summary: Homi Adajania's 'Cocktail 2' featuring Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon, and Rashmika Mandanna is making waves at the box office, having surpassed Rs 100 crore globally and nearing Rs 70 crore in India alone. Although reviews have been mixed, the romantic drama capturing a contemporary love triangle had a robust opening weekend, and its impressive performance on the seventh day suggests it may reach even greater heights soon.
